title: Concept: React dangerouslySetInnerHTML shipped in a bundle
description: A React component that assigns markup through dangerouslySetInnerHTML in a response gives every reader of that response the same information the bank holds internally: The prop bypasses React's escaping by design, so any value that reaches it becomes live DOM; shipped in a response, it tells a reader exactly where the escaping stops.
applicability: One unbounded data path into this prop converts a stored string into script execution in every visitor's session.
risk: React escapes by default; this prop is the documented exception and must be treated as a sink.
